mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before every lifecycle run, resumption, schedule registration, or skill distribution change.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Current registry digest, valid source/install inventory, and declared test class for every active skill.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before planning, implementing, debugging, enhancing, or testing repository behavior.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Current code-graph or recorded source-and-test trace; refresh changed surfaces after meaningful edits.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before admitting a material product goal or selecting a delivery slice.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Accepted goal, material assumptions/experiments, mapped requirements, acceptance criteria, and selected admissible work.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before implementation starts or a run resumes implementation.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: One selected delivery engine, run identity, budget, admission decision, and parent-goal acceptance criteria.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Whenever architecture, tools, data, models, security, privacy, resilience, or user trust are materially affected.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Applicable specialist contracts, risk decisions, owners, and verification boundaries linked to the run identity.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Whenever a material check fails, work is blocked, help is required, or a run is restarted.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Failure reproduction, attempted repair history, budget state, targeted help packet or park condition, and verified wake condition.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before a delivery slice or parent goal is reported complete.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Finding-to-reproduction-to-repair-to-retest chain, independent closure, and current parent-goal acceptance evidence.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Enterprise AI assurance is requested or required by the product risk profile, including enterprise readiness and material model/autonomy changes.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: One subject/profile/verifier-bound run; thirteen applicability dispositions; raw signed owner evidence; persistent known-unaddressed risks; authenticated independent challenge; scoped current decision; one delivery engine; no implicit deployment authority.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Before a release decision, deployment, migration, agent promotion, or other live external effect.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Named GO/NO_GO/ESCALATE decision, target identity, authority, fresh live evidence, and verified rollback or compensation path.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: After a live product capability is released or material user feedback is received.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Observed signal, interpretation, owner, backlog consequence, and stakeholder communication where required.

mandatory_steps.applies_when: Whenever a personal skill, loop package, alias, mirror, or lifecycle policy changes.
mandatory_steps.required_evidence: Regenerated lifecycle map, UTF-8 fleet validation, declared test result, reviewed distribution diff, and updated registry hashes.

enterprise_assurance.compatibility: Version 1.0.0 non-enterprise runs remain readable; current revocation and security floors still apply.
